d:
Long, sleek silver white hair flowing down to the shoulders. Sharp, piercing crimson red eyes. Apparent age is late thirties and sophisticated. A tall, broad-shouldered muscular build. Wears a high-collared black velvet frock coat with silver buttons over a crisp white dress shirt and black trousers. Signature details include a floating, ornate silver rapier and two large, majestic silver white feathered wings.
BODY COLOR: pale white
